log_file.description: Path to the main RADIUS log file.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog instead of files (e.g., auth, daemon, local0).

log_stripped_names.description: If true, strip domain/realm from usernames before logging.

log_auth_badpass.description: Log failed authentication attempts, including passwords (use only in secure environments).

log_auth_goodpass.description: Log successful authentication attempts with passwords (use only in secure environments).

run_user.description: System user under which the FreeRADIUS daemon will run for security isolation.

run_group.description: System group under which the FreeRADIUS daemon will run.

core_dump.description: Whether to allow core dumps on crash. Not recommended in production.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the daemon.

include_modules_dir.description: If true, automatically include module configs from raddb/mods-available/. Disable if using custom loading.

include_sites_dir.description: If true, include site configurations from raddb/sites-available/.

max_requests.description: Maximum number of simultaneous requests the server will handle.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds after which idle client connections are closed.

auth_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) the server waits for a response during authentication.

pkt_delay.description: Delay (milliseconds) before retransmitting a request packet (used for testing).

max_clients_per_ip.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients allowed per IP (0 = unlimited).

enable_threads.description: Enable thread pool for improved throughput under load.

num_threads.description: Number of threads in the pool when thread pool is enabled.

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for pending requests during graceful shutdown.

auth_ipaddr.description: List of IP addresses (or ['*'] for all) on which the server listens for RADIUS access-request packets.

auth_port.description: UDP port to listen on for authentication requests.

acct_ipaddr.description: List of IP addresses (or ['*'] for all) on which the server listens for RADIUS accounting-request packets.

acct_port.description: UDP port to listen on for accounting requests.

interface.description: Network interface name to bind to (e.g., eth0). Overrides ipaddr binding. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

max_auth_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent authentication connections per listener.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the authentication listener (required for EAP-TLS, PEAP, TTLS, etc.).

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify client certificates (when SSL enabled).

server_cert_path.description: Path to the server certificate (PEM format, includes chain if needed).

server_key_path.description: Path to the server private key (PEM format, unencrypted).

dh_file_path.description: Path to Diffie-Hellman parameters file (optional, auto-generated if missing).

cipher_list.description: TLS cipher suites allowed for TLS negotiation (EAP-TLS/TTLS/PEAP).

radius_clients.description: List of NAS/clients to authenticate. Each entry defines a RADIUS client.

ipaddr.description: IP address (IPv4/IPv6) or subnet (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) of the client.

secret.description: Shared secret between this server and the NAS client.

require_message_authenticator.description: If true, require Message-Authenticator attribute on all packets (recommended for EAP).

max_connections.description: Max concurrent connections from this client.

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) for connections from this client.
